decision: Fictional long-duration transit with configurable link availability. ISS documents inform task patterns, not exact future staffing or habitat layout.
A qualified change becomes an understandable, owned and traceable follow-up even while Earth is unavailable.
Separate job, active duty, medical qualification, mission assignment, access grant and episode owner. Correct the single-CMO seed limitation without inventing real people.
Keep research subjects, synthetic crew and any future operational records in separate namespaces and access domains.
A spatial viewer over a deterministic scenario engine; no independent clinical logic or physiological truth in the renderer.
Evaluate explanation and source retrieval against templates; structured rules and authorized humans own consequential actions. Fine-tuning awaits a justified task and evaluation.
Visual crew brief, background fictional replay, real research CBC import/quality report, then accountable review/handoff.
Public synthetic demo and clinical mission deployment are different releases with different gates.
Reconcile full objectives/resources and early-work eligibility when authoritative material is available; keep honest creation history.
A qualified health reviewer must validate interpretation, comparability and allowed follow-up; access does not equal approval.
